about_me.title: About Me
about_me.description: My life is the rhythm of the track. As a high-performance athlete, every training session and competition is a commitment to my dream: always giving my best to push my limits. Speed skating is my passion and my language, where I turn discipline into progress and challenges into triumphs. This is the determination that drives me to go further every day, because when you put heart and passion into it, there's no goal you can't achieve.

my_path.title: My Journey
my_path.description: From my first steps on wheels, I knew my place was on the track. My journey is not just a series of competitions, but a story of perseverance, sacrifice, and an unwavering passion for speed. Every day is an opportunity to be stronger, faster, and more resilient. My goal is not just to win medals, but to inspire others to pursue their dreams with the same determination.

why_sponsor_me.title: Why Sponsor Me?
why_sponsor_me.subtitle: Investing in my career is more than a sponsorship; it's a strategic alliance to grow together and reach new heights.
why_sponsor_me.benefit1_description: Associate your brand with speed and success. Gain exposure in national and international competitions, social media, and communication channels, reaching thousands of sports enthusiasts.
why_sponsor_me.benefit2_description: Aligning your company with values of discipline, self-improvement, and passion inspires trust and loyalty. Demonstrate your commitment to young talent and sporting excellence.
why_sponsor_me.benefit3_description: Your support not only boosts my career but also inspires a new generation of athletes. Become a pillar for the community and an agent of change through sport.
why_sponsor_me.benefit4_description: I offer unique marketing opportunities, from exclusive social media content to the presence of your logo on my equipment. Generate a measurable return while supporting a dream.
